text: In the Lab 14 / Gauthier Lorenz setup (d=3, history [u_t, u_{t-1}], degree 2), what is the total NVAR feature dimension D?
explanation: The lagged input is 6-dimensional (3 variables × 2 time steps): 6 linear terms plus C(7,2)=21 unique quadratic products give D = 6 + 21 = 27, matching Gauthier et al. Table 1. 54 is the larger d=3, 2-extra-delay case; 500 is the ESN reservoir size N; 9 counts only linear terms for three delays.
